rules.title: Repository is public
rules.description: The GitHub repository has public visibility.
rules.remediation: Make the repository private unless it is meant to be open source.

rules.title: Default branch is not protected
rules.description: The default branch has no branch protection. Needs attribute default_branch_protected (not emitted by the collector yet, so unknown never violates).
rules.remediation: Enable branch protection with required reviews on the default branch.

rules.title: Open Dependabot alert
rules.description: A Dependabot alert is open on the repository.
rules.remediation: Update the vulnerable dependency or dismiss the alert with a reason.

rules.title: Open secret scanning alert
rules.description: A secret scanning alert is open on the repository.
rules.remediation: Revoke the exposed secret, rotate it and close the alert.
